tools.name: mermaid-to-url
tools.description:
Convert Mermaid diagram code to image URL. This tool generates a URL that can be used to:
1. Display the diagram directly in AI/LLM responses
2. Download and save the diagram as an image file
3. Share the diagram through the generated URL

Note: For SVG format, it's recommended to use the mermaid-to-svg tool instead as it provides direct access to the SVG content.

Supports multiple output formats (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF) and customization options like themes, colors, and dimensions.

type.description:
Output format:
- jpeg: JPEG image format
- png: PNG image format
- webp: WebP image format
- svg: SVG vector format (default)
- pdf: PDF document format

theme.description:
Theme setting:
- default: Default theme for general use
- neutral: Neutral theme suitable for black and white printing
- dark: Dark theme for dark backgrounds
- forest: Forest theme with green color scheme

bgColor.description:
Background color:
- Hex color code (e.g., 'FF0000' for red)
- Named color with '!' prefix (e.g., '!white')

width.description:
Image width in pixels
Required for using scale parameter

height.description:
Image height in pixels
Required for using scale parameter

scale.description:
Scale factor (1-3)
Only effective when width or height is set

fit.description:
PDF auto-fit:
- When true, PDF will automatically adjust to diagram size
- Only effective for PDF output

paper.description:
PDF paper size (e.g., 'a4', 'a3', 'letter')
Only effective for PDF output when fit=false

landscape.description:
PDF landscape mode:
- When true, PDF will use landscape orientation
- Only effective for PDF output when fit=false

tools.name: mermaid-to-file
tools.description:
Convert Mermaid diagram code to image and save to Downloads folder or specified absolute path. This tool generates an image file from the diagram and saves it to the system Downloads folder or a specified absolute path.
The filename can be provided with or without extension - if the extension is missing or doesn't match the output format, the correct extension will be automatically added.

tools.name: mermaid-to-svg
tools.description:
Convert Mermaid diagram code to SVG content. This tool is the recommended way to get SVG output as it provides direct access to the SVG markup, which can be used for:
1. Direct embedding in HTML/XML documents
2. Further SVG manipulation or styling
3. Vector-based scaling without quality loss

The tool returns the raw SVG content as a string, making it ideal for any use case requiring vector graphics or SVG manipulation.
